posts.title: Hardening The Shell
posts.description: Don't get me wrong, I'm not massively worried about anyone cloning Eggnob -- it's a stupid joke, made to make me and a few chums on Mastodon giggle -- but... We do live in 2026. posts.title: Wil Overton Magic
posts.description: The mighty Wil Overton is back on key-art duties for Eggnob. Considering the complete lack of direction that I gave him -- "a farting egg, legally distinct from Dizzy" -- I think he's done a eggcellent job! And now that's in place, all the final bits and pieces have been filled in on the Steam page, and pushed into review with Valve. Hopefully, I'll be able to share the links in two or three days.
